issue.title: feat: need issue templates for bugs, features, docs, perf
issue.body: This repo (and [@resnovas/.github](https://github.com/Resnovas/.github)) is missing templates that would allow users to submit issues. These templates need creating. These templates should match the Linear templates so that everything is consistent across platforms. I believe the guidance on the templates already exists in the contributing guidelines, and agent policies - so they just need setting up here.
